title: StreamEval: Evaluating Interactive Streaming Video Generation Models
title_zh: StreamEval：交互式流式视频生成模型评测

paragraphs.en: 总结：StreamEval是首个交互式流式视频生成统一基准，涵盖五大任务、37个模型评测，揭示请求执行与状态一致性仍是核心挑战。 As streaming video generation advances, enabling real-time interaction with generated video is becoming increasingly important. We introduce StreamEval, a unified benchmark for interactive streaming video generation spanning five tasks: avatar dialogue, avatar performance, world generation, instruction editing, and reference editing. StreamEval comprises 300 scripted test cases lasting 15-300s, each specifying initial assets, incrementally arriving multimodal requests, and explicit requirements for state changes and content preservation. Performance is assessed along four evaluation dimensions: task execution, state consistency, visual fidelity, and audiovisual coordination, instantiated through ten task-specific metrics on a 0-100 scale. Evaluating 37 distinct models across 300 test cases, we find that high visual quality and identity retention do not necessarily coincide with reliable request execution or sustained state consistency. In particular, request execution remains challenging: the highest task-specific scores are 36.90 for Following among seven avatar-performance models, 25.93 for Following in text-conditioned world generation, and 15.00 for Edit Success among three reported reference-editing models. These findings identify reliable request execution under timing and preservation constraints as a central challenge for advancing omni-modal real-time interactive systems. The leaderboard is available at https://streameval.ai
paragraphs.zh: 总结：StreamEval是首个交互式流式视频生成统一基准，涵盖五大任务、37个模型评测，揭示请求执行与状态一致性仍是核心挑战。随着流式视频生成技术的进步，实现对生成视频的实时交互正变得越来越重要。 我们提出StreamEval，一个用于交互式流式视频生成的统一基准，涵盖五大任务：数字人对话、数字人表演、世界生成、指令编辑和参考编辑。 StreamEval包含300个时长为15-300秒的脚本化测试用例，每个用例指定初始资产、逐步到达的多模态请求，以及针对状态变化和内容保持的明确要求。 性能沿四个评估维度进行评估：任务执行、状态一致性、视觉保真度和视听协调，并通过十项任务特定指标在0-100分制上具体呈现。 通过对300个测试用例中的37个不同模型进行评估，我们发现高视觉质量和身份保持并不一定与可靠的请求执行或持续的状态一致性相吻合。 特别是，请求执行仍然具有挑战性：七个数字人表演模型中Following的最高任务得分为36.90，文本条件世界生成中Following的得分为25.93，而三个已报告的参考编辑模型中Edit Success的得分仅为15.00。 这些发现表明，在时序和保持约束下实现可靠的请求执行，是推进全模态实时交互系统的一项核心挑战。 排行榜可在 https://streameval.ai 获取
